newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Feb 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Feb 7.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- French Supreme Court on Thursday threw out appeals by three public figures convicted of receiving proceeds resulting from misuse of corporate funds who had cited in their arguments the statute of limitations.
-- IMF managing director Michel Camdessus in an interview says that he believes world currency levels are normalising and that this could be lasting.
Camdessus says Japanese yen should not fall on a scale which would require the Bank of Japan to raise interest rates.

-- Alcatel Alsthom chairman Serge Tchuruk says in an interview that he is seeking a substantial stake in defence electronics group Thomson-CSF, urges government to sell its 58-percent Thomson-CSF stake through private placements and not a public offering.

-- CDR structure selling off Credit Lyonnais assets seeks an estimate of the value of its 25-percent stake in Francois Pinault's personal holding Artemis. Goldman Sachs to launch an international tender to seek a bidder.
